verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm Community Edition is free/MIT-licensed and self-hostable on own infrastructure with full data ownership, with an Enterprise Edition adding SAML SSO, on-prem deployment, and audit logs; community comments corroborate self-hosting is functional, though with some noted limitations (e.g., desktop login/self-host quirks). Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the full self-host deployment process at scale and no contradicting evidence about core self-host functionality itself.
